name: WA-10
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +9 partisan lean
Incumbent Strickland running with a large fundraising advantage
Polymarket prices Strickland at 96% to win
No public polling of the general election
model.rationale: Strickland is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic by nine points, and prediction markets price her near-certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late polling showing the challenger within single digits, or a major outside-spending surge against Strickland, would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Marilyn Strickland, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a district whose partisan lean favors her party by nine points. She has raised about $1.5 million and holds roughly $677,000 on hand, while Republican challenger Chris Chung has reported no fundraising figures and draws no outside support on either side. Prediction markets give Strickland about a 96 percent chance of winning.

No public general-election polling or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the clear financial edge. The forecast calls this Safe D, with Strickland expected to win by roughly twenty points.
